generators.carrier: admitted forms with slot tuples; plugging fills every hole with the same datum
set of well-formed contexts whose plugging is derivable

relations.statement: Derivable(x) iff x is in the admitted instances or covered by a uniform all-tuples rule; no other inference
Collapsed(a,b) iff profile(a)=profile(b); separable(a,b) iff exists well-formed context C derivable for exactly one of a,b
relations.hypotheses: separability means positive derivability difference only

lemmas.statement: If a and b are separable then their profiles differ, i.e. not collapsed
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem sep_not_collapsed {D C : Type} (der : C -> D -> Prop) (a b : D) (h : exists c, (der c a /\ not der c b) \/ (der c b /\ not der c a)) : (fun c => der c a) != (fun c => der c b) := by sorry

near_misses.claim: A declared requirement for separation implies the data are actually separable
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: An imposed requirement records a demand only and does not make separation hold; separability needs a derivable context for one datum and not the other

near_misses.claim: Data are separable if some context is non-derivable for one and also non-derivable for the other under a different reason
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Separability is a difference in positive derivability only, so two non-derivable plugs do not separate
